steps.goal: 理解上一阶段实现及完整场景的海面与展览绑定范围
steps.expected: 确认数值算法、入口与全部海面LOD节点，识别应保留的材质及控制
steps.counterexample: 入口或海面识别不完整，误包含独立展示样品
observations: effect/main.gd computes 64x64 periodic Gerstner positions, derivatives, Jacobian and foam history; ocean_surface.gd targets DeepOcean while preserving host scene.
steps.summary: Existing implementation already preserves host scene and targets DeepOcean.

steps.goal: 将世界坐标波与参数泡沫绑定全部海面LOD且隔离展览样品
steps.expected: 近中远海面使用同一波场与泡沫，其他材质不变
steps.counterexample: LOD漏绑或展览材质被替换
observations: observations/render_20260924_232632_7bbe82e5; overview camera frames 1 and 180; log reports near_lod_tiles=81, mid_far_meshes=2, binding_errors=0.
steps.summary: All 81 near tiles and 2 far meshes share the private wave/foam material; only generated DeepOcean meshes are touched.

steps.goal: 核验移动相机时海面连续性及固定数值输出
steps.expected: 波泡沫保持世界锚定，样本字段顺序和时间推进正确
steps.counterexample: 相机移动导致波场滑动、接缝或输出错误
observations: observations/render_20260924_232632_7bbe82e5; frames 1 and 180 show stable world-anchored wave pattern; WAVE_HISTORY_VERIFY errors remain below 5e-7 position and 3e-8 Jacobian, foam max reaches 0.095935.
steps.summary: CPU samples and shader history agree; q is captured before displacement and history is shared by every LOD.
steps.limitations: No interactive input replay beyond render camera observation.

steps.goal: 在scene/main.tscn完整目标场景复查海面覆盖及既有展览行为
steps.expected: 完整海面、海床地形、独立样品、天空HUD和相机控制保留
steps.counterexample: 完整场景有缺失、报错或明显覆盖断裂
observations: scene/main.tscn rendered successfully with 109 visible geometry, no runtime errors; HUD, seabed/terrain and host environment visible in overview captures.
steps.summary: Complete host scene remains active and effect render is clean.
